raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

We serve DeepSeek-V4-Flash (v0.5.22) to Claude Code over `/v1/responses` and were getting almost no prefix cache hits on long agent sessions.

Claude Code appends a system message with a `<total_tokens>` counter after every tool result. #40077 keeps such messages in place, but only when `supports_inline_system` is true, and for native encoders that's just `kimi_k3`. On `dsv4` (and `dsv32`, `--chat-template`, or system-first Jinja templates) `_construct_input_messages` still merges every system/developer message into the leading system block. So each turn the counter changes near the top of the prompt and the radix cache can't match anything after it.

Easy to reproduce with a ~3.5K token request against a single replica:

| Request | Cached tokens |
|---|---|
| First request | 0 |
| Same request again | 3,328 |
| Same request, only the `<total_tokens>` number changed | 0 |

We worked around it in our gateway by sending late system messages as user turns, which is what this PR does inside SGLang. Production traffic from the same client, before (Oct 20, 10:28-14:13 UTC) and after (14:13-14:48 UTC). The windows aren't matched, so take it as a rough comparison:

| | Before | After |
|---|---|---|
| Requests | 1,871 | 760 |
| Median prompt | ~73K | ~77K |
| Cache hit rate (token-weighted) | 6% | 97% |
| Median uncached prefill | 68,903 | 960 |
| Median request duration | 7.2 s | 1.3 s |
| p90 request duration | 24.1 s | 9.4 s |

Short replies (<300 output tokens) on 120K+ prompts went from 9.0 s to 1.0 s median.

Adding `dsv4` to the allowlist instead wouldn't work. Since #45315, dsv4 renders through deepseek-recipe, and recipe itself moves inline `system` messages up to the leading system block, so they have to reach it as something else.

## Modifications

On the merge path, system/developer messages before the first turn are still merged into the leading block, and later ones are now sent as user turns where they are. The developer label is kept, and since this runs after the stored history is added, it also covers `previous_response_id`. With dsv4, recipe puts the converted message in the same user turn as the preceding tool result, so the rendered prompt has no extra user turn.

The tradeoff is that late instructions now appear as user turns, not system. #42533 does the same for `/v1/messages`.

## Tests

Updated the merge-path cases in `test_inline_instruction_keeps_history_prefix` and added tests for a reminder after a tool result, the `previous_response_id` case, and a 4-turn agent loop rendered through deepseek-recipe's dsv4 encoding that checks each turn's prompt ids are a prefix of the next. The new tests fail on main.

<!-- pr-states:start -->
---

Latest PR Test (Extra): <!-- slot:pr-test-extra:start -->:x: [Run #40300370721](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/actions/runs/40300370721)<!-- slot:pr-test-extra:end -->

files.patch:
@@ -1682,11 +1682,16 @@ def _construct_input_messages(
             return messages
 
         # Most chat templates expect a single leading ``system`` message;
-        # coalesce any ``instructions`` + interleaved ``developer`` entries.
+        # coalesce ``instructions`` + the ``developer`` entries before the first
+        # turn. Later ones are sent as user turns in place: hoisting them would
+        # rewrite the prompt prefix on every appended instruction.
         system_chunks: list[str] = []
         other_msgs: list = []
         for m in messages:
-            if isinstance(m, dict) and m.get("role") == "system":
+            is_system = isinstance(m, dict) and m.get("role") == "system"
+            if is_system and other_msgs:
+                other_msgs.append({**m, "role": "user"})
+            elif is_system:
                 content = m.get("content")
                 if isinstance(content, str):
                     system_chunks.append(content)

@@ -36,6 +36,7 @@
     ResponsesRequest,
     ResponsesResponse,
 )
+from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.responses_adapters import DEVELOPER_BLOCK_LABEL
 from sglang.srt.entrypoints.openai.serving_responses import (
     OpenAIServingResponses,
     _build_output_text_logprobs,
@@ -49,7 +50,7 @@
 )
 from sglang.srt.server_args import ServerArgs
 from sglang.test.ci.ci_register import register_cpu_ci
-from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase
+from sglang.test.test_utils import CustomTestCase, is_in_ci
 
 register_cpu_ci(est_time=10, suite="base-a-test-cpu")
 
@@ -2122,13 +2123,131 @@ def test_inline_instruction_keeps_history_prefix(
             model="x", instructions="Stable instructions", input=history + appended
         )
     )
-    if preserve:
-        assert after[: len(before)] == before
-        assert after[len(before)]["role"] == "system"
-        assert "New instruction" in after[len(before)]["content"]
-    else:
+    assert after[: len(before)] == before
+    assert after[len(before)]["role"] == ("system" if preserve else "user")
+    assert "New instruction" in after[len(before)]["content"]
+    if not preserve:
         assert [m["role"] for m in after].count("system") == 1
-        assert "New instruction" in after[0]["content"]
+
+
+def _merge_path_serving() -> OpenAIServingResponses:
+    publish(ServerArgs(model_path="dummy"), role="tokenizer")
+    with patch.object(
+        OpenAIServingResponses, "_resolve_chat_encoding_spec", return_value="dsv32"
+    ):
+        serving = OpenAIServingResponses(MockTokenizerManager(), MockTemplateManager())
+    assert not serving.supports_inline_system
+    return serving
+
+
+def test_merge_path_sends_later_instructions_as_user_turns():
+    """Only instructions before the first turn are coalesced; later system and
+    developer messages stay in place (the developer label survives)."""
+    serving = _merge_path_serving()
+    request = ResponsesRequest(
+        model="x",
+        instructions="Stable instructions",
+        input=[
+            {"role": "developer", "content": "Leading"},
+            {"role": "user", "content": "Run it"},
+            {
+                "type": "function_call",
+                "call_id": "c1",
+                "name": "run",
+                "arguments": "{}",
+            },
+            {"type": "function_call_output", "call_id": "c1", "output": "done"},
+            {"role": "system", "content": "<total_tokens>9</total_tokens>"},
+            {"role": "developer", "content": "Later"},
+        ],
+        store=False,
+    )
+    messages = serving._construct_input_messages(request)
+    assert [m["role"] for m in messages] == [
+        "system",
+        "user",
+        "assistant",
+        "tool",
+        "user",
+        "user",
+    ]
+    assert "Stable instructions" in messages[0]["content"]
+    assert "Leading" in messages[0]["content"]
+    assert messages[4]["content"] == "<total_tokens>9</total_tokens>"
+    assert messages[5]["content"] == f"{DEVELOPER_BLOCK_LABEL}\nLater"
+
+
+def test_merge_path_keeps_stored_history_prefix():
+    """With ``previous_response_id`` the stored turns come first, so an instruction
+    at the start of the new ``input`` is already mid-conversation."""
+    serving = _merge_path_serving()
+    serving.msg_store["resp_1"] = [
+        {"role": "user", "content": "Existing conversation"},
+        {"role": "assistant", "content": "Previous answer"},
+    ]
+    request = ResponsesRequest(
+        model="x",
+        previous_response_id="resp_1",
+        input=[{"role": "developer", "content": "New instruction"}],
+    )
+    messages = serving._construct_input_messages(request)
+    assert [m["role"] for m in messages] == ["user", "assistant", "user"]
+    assert "New instruction" in messages[2]["content"]
+
+
+def _dsv4_recipe():
+    """deepseek-recipe's DeepSeek-V4 renderer; only outside CI does an unreachable
+    Hub skip the test."""
+    from huggingface_hub import hf_hub_download
+    from tokenizers import Tokenizer
+
+    from sglang.srt.parser.deepseek_recipe_renderer import DeepSeekRecipe
+
+    try:
+        path = hf_hub_download(
+            "deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017",
+            "tokenizer.json",
+            revision="1bae0e1088993b9b82de08f59de5be5a34e42170",
+        )
+    except Exception as error:  # noqa: BLE001
+        if is_in_ci():
+            raise
+        pytest.skip(f"the tokenizer is not available: {error}")
+    return DeepSeekRecipe("dsv4", Tokenizer.from_file(path))
+
+
+def test_dsv4_prompt_is_extended_not_rewritten_each_turn():
+    """Render an agent loop that appends a system reminder after every tool result
+    through deepseek-recipe, which itself moves inline system messages to the top:
+    each turn's prompt ids must be a prefix of the next, and the reminder must
+    stay in the last user turn."""
+    serving = _merge_path_serving()
+    recipe = _dsv4_recipe()
+    items = [{"role": "user", "content": "Fix the bug"}]
+    prompts = []
+    for turn in range(4):
+        reminder = f"<total_tokens>{1000 - turn}</total_tokens>"
+        items = items + [{"role": "system", "content": reminder}]
+        messages = serving._construct_input_messages(
+            ResponsesRequest(
+                model="x", instructions="Stable instructions", input=items, store=False
+            )
+        )
+        prompt = recipe.encode({"messages": messages, "thinking": False})
+        text = recipe.hf_tokenizer.decode(prompt, skip_special_tokens=False)
+        assert reminder in text.rsplit("<｜User｜>", 1)[1]
+        prompts.append(prompt)
+        items = items + [
+            {
+                "type": "function_call",
+                "call_id": f"c{turn}",
+                "name": "run",
+                "arguments": "{}",
+            },
+            {"type": "function_call_output", "call_id": f"c{turn}", "output": "ok"},
+        ]
+    for before, after in zip(prompts, prompts[1:]):
+        assert after[: len(before)] == before
 
 
 @pytest.mark.parametrize("stream", [False, True])
